The current asking price of residential land in the Ibuowo / Owotutu area of Bariga, Shomolu, Lagos ranges between ₦250,000 and ₦415,000 per square meter.

Owode / Orile Bariga.query: Current asking price of residential land per sqm in Owode  / Orile Bariga, Shomolu Lagos Nigeria
Owode / Orile Bariga.text:
The current asking price for residential land in Owode / Orile Bariga, Shomolu, Lagos ranges between ₦95,000 and ₦250,000 per square meter ($60 to $160 USD/sqm), depending on the exact proximity to the road, land typography, and available titles.
Market listings from platforms like the Nigeria Property Centre and Jiji Nigeria highlight the breakdown below:
Land Price Breakdown by Plot Size
Because land in this built-up area is rarely sold strictly by individual square meters, transactions usually happen in half or full plots:
Half Plot (~250 to 300 sqm): Ranges from ₦25 million to ₦45 million. This breaks down to roughly ₦96,000 – ₦150,000 per sqm.
Standard Full Plot (~400 to 500 sqm): Ranges from ₦75 million to ₦120 million for inner residential streets. This averages ₦150,000 – ₦240,000 per sqm .
Premium / Main Road Plots: Properties facing major access roads or those ready for immediate redevelopment (often containing demolishable structures) go for ₦150 million to ₦350 million, pushing the square meter rate well above ₦300,000 – ₦600,000 per sqm .
Key Price Determinants in Orile Bariga
Title Documents: Land with a registered Certificate of Occupancy (C of O) or Governor's Consent commands the absolute highest premium. Plots sold with only a Family Receipt and Survey Plan trade at a discount but carry higher verification risks.
Accessibility: Owode and Orile Bariga are highly sought after due to their proximity to Akoka (UNILAG), Yaba, and easy access to the Third Mainland Bridge. Plots closer to these exit points cost significantly more.
Topography: This pocket of Shomolu has varying marshy conditions; solid, gated "dry land" carries an immediate price premium over areas prone to seasonal waterlogging.
